characters.name: Askeladden
characters.description: Askeladden is a young man of average height and slender build, exuding a rustic charm. He has medium-length, tousled brown hair, bright eyes filled with curiosity, and a playful smile. His attire is simple and travel-worn, consisting of a loose-fitting tunic and trousers in earthy tones, with a pair of sturdy boots. He carries a mix of unusual items, including a skull, a piece of parchment, and a mackerel, which he holds in his hands with a sense of purpose. He stands confidently at the entrance of a grand royal castle, indicating his ambition and determination to succeed in his quest.

characters.name: Kongen
characters.description: Kongen is an older man of imposing stature, with an air of authority and wisdom. He has a full beard and hair that has turned silver with age, complementing his noble features. Clad in luxurious robes of deep red and gold, he exudes regality from his seat inside the grand hall of the castle. He listens intently to Askeladden, surrounded by curious courtiers who mirror his keen interest.

characters.name: Prinsessen
characters.description: Prinsessen is a young woman of remarkable beauty and grace, captivating the room with her presence. She has long, flowing golden hair, delicate features, and clear blue eyes that reflect her intrigue and intelligence. Her attire is elegant, a gown of soft blues and whites that befits her royal stature. As Askeladden presents each of his curious items, her expression shifts from intrigue to amazement, showing her engagement with the ongoing dialogue.
